summary: Implemented the Decathlon datalist loader. Changes: monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (new; load_decathalon_datalist plus private _resolve_path, using only os and json), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" subsection with an autofunction entry in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities block, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py (new; class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist with the four specified tests, each cleaning up its temp directory). Nothing was committed. Tests and Black were not run, per instructions; I only checked that no line exceeds 120 columns. Choices beyond the spec: a non-list value under the data list key raises ValueError; JSON parse errors are re-raised as ValueError naming the file.
